The branch changes iMessage, Telegram webhook/probe/ingress-worker, and ClickClack gateway shutdown/backoff code plus regression tests to clear timers, catch shutdown rejections, make stop idempotent, and respect abort during reconnect waits.

PR surface: Source +41, Tests +309. Total +350 across 10 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for source-level reproduction: current main still has the raw timers, fire-and-forget shutdown/close calls, and abort-ignoring reconnect wait, and the PR body includes negative-control unit test output. I did not establish a live channel or gateway reproduction in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(channels): fix five channel lifecycle/shutdown bugs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Five small channel reliability bugs where lifecycle/shutdown paths can leak timers, unhandled rejections, or ignore abort signals.

1. **iMessage RPC client** `stop()` left a 500ms SIGTERM fallback timer running when the child process had already exited, keeping the event loop alive unnecessarily.
2. **Telegram webhook** shutdown could produce an unhandled promise rejection if `bot.stop()` or transport close threw inside the abort listener.
3. **Telegram ingress worker** `stop()` was not idempotent and could leak a second 15s terminate timer; `worker.terminate()` rejections were unhandled.
4. **Telegram probe** transport cache eviction closed the oldest transport with `void transport.close()`, so a rejecting `close()` became an unhandled rejection.
5. **ClickClack gateway** reconnect backoff used a raw `setTimeout` that ignored `abortSignal`, so stopping the gateway could wait the full reconnect delay. It also leaked an abort listener on every normal reconnect.

## Why This Change Was Made
- iMessage: store the fallback timer, `unref` it, and clear it once the child-close race settles.
- Telegram webhook: catch shutdown errors inside the abort paths, route them to `runtime.error`, and continue owned transport/status cleanup even if `bot.stop()` rejects.
- Telegram ingress worker: guard `stop()` with a `stopped` flag and catch `worker.terminate()` rejections.
- Telegram probe: wrap the close result with `Promise.resolve(...).catch(...)` so both sync and async rejections are swallowed safely.
- ClickClack gateway: attach an abort listener that clears the reconnect timeout and resolves the wait promise immediately, then remove that listener once either path settles so repeated reconnects do not accumulate stale listeners.

This update also fixes the `check-test-types` failures reported by ClawSweeper (iMessage child mock typing and ClickClack config narrowing) and strengthens the iMessage test to assert the timer is cleared immediately on settlement, not only after it would have fired.

## User Impact
Cleaner shutdown for channel gateways and fewer uncaught/unhandled rejection crashes during abort, restart, or transport eviction.

## Real behavior proof

**Environment:** Linux, Node v22.22.0, pnpm 11.2.2.

The proof swaps each fixed source file back to `origin/main`, runs the relevant regression test, restores the fix, and runs the test again. The negative controls reproduce the original bugs (timeout/hang, leaked timer, unhandled rejection) while the restored-fix runs pass cleanly.

### ClickClack reconnect backoff ignores abort

Negative control (`extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.ts` from `origin/main`):

```text
$ timeout 12 pnpm test extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.test.ts -- --run -t "exits immediately when aborted during reconnect backoff"
[test] test/vitest/vitest.extensions.config.ts exited by signal SIGTERM
exit=124 (timeout/hang)
```

Fix restored:

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.test.ts -- --run -t "exits immediately when aborted during reconnect backoff"
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 6 skipped (7)
   Duration  4.57s
exit=0
```

### iMessage SIGTERM fallback timer leak

Negative control (`extensions/imessage/src/client.ts` from `origin/main`):

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/imessage/src/client.test.ts -- --run -t "clears the SIGTERM fallback timer"
 FAIL  |extension-imessage| extensions/imessage/src/client.test.ts > IMessageRpcClient.stop > clears the SIGTERM fallback timer
AssertionError: expected 1 to be +0
    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
exit=1
```

Fix restored:

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/imessage/src/client.test.ts -- --run -t "clears the SIGTERM fallback timer"
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 1 skipped (2)
   Duration  912ms
exit=0
```

### Telegram webhook unhandled rejection on shutdown

Negative control (`extensions/telegram/src/webhook.ts` from `origin/main`):

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/telegram/src/webhook.test.ts -- --run -t "does not leak unhandled rejections when shutdown throws"
⎯⎯⎯⎯ Unhandled Rejection ⎯⎯⎯
Error: bot stop failed
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
exit=1
```

Fix restored:

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/telegram/src/webhook.test.ts -- --run -t "does not leak unhandled rejections when shutdown throws"
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 29 skipped (30)
exit=0
```

### Repro script

`/tmp/proof-channel-lifecycle.sh` automates the same negative-control / restore cycle shown above.

## Evidence

All fixes are accompanied by regression tests:

```text
extensions/imessage/src/client.test.ts                     2 passed
extensions/telegram/src/webhook.test.ts                   30 passed
extensions/telegram/src/telegram-ingress-worker.test.ts    2 passed
extensions/telegram/src/probe.test.ts                     14 passed
extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.test.ts                  7 passed
```

Run locally with:

```bash
pnpm test extensions/imessage/src/client.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/webhook.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/telegram-ingress-worker.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/probe.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.test.ts -- --run
```

Local validation also passes:

```text
$ pnpm format:check extensions/imessage/src/client.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/webhook.ts extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ pnpm lint:all -- extensions/imessage/src/client.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/webhook.ts extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.ts
(no errors)

$ pnpm tsgo:extensions:test
(no errors)
```

---

@clawsweeper re-review

Addressed the review blockers:
- Fixed `check-test-types` failures in `extensions/imessage/src/client.test.ts` and `extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.test.ts`.
- Moved Telegram webhook owned-transport/status cleanup into a `finally` so `bot.stop()` rejections no longer skip cleanup.
- Removed the ClickClack reconnect abort listener after either the timer fires normally or abort resolves, mirroring the websocket-cycle cleanup pattern.
- Added negative controls for the three bugs above by temporarily restoring `origin/main` source and showing the tests fail/hang, then restoring the fix and showing them pass.
